title: MLAG Peer-Link Degraded — DC1_L3_LEAF1 Port-Channel3
symptom: Port-Channel3 (MLAG peer-link) on dc1-leaf1a lost one member link. Peer-link at 50% capacity. Intermittent drops under load.
root_cause: Ethernet3 on dc1-leaf1a (one of two Port-Channel3 peer-link members) is shutdown. Peer-link degraded but MLAG domain still Active.
